name: Circuit Gilles Villeneuve
summary: A track on an island in the St. Lawrence River, with a wall that has caught several world champions.
character: Long straights linked by chicanes and a hairpin, so braking and traction are what count. The walls sit close to the kerbs and punish small mistakes. The local groundhogs sometimes get involved too.

corners.name: Wall of Champions
corners.note: The wall on the exit of the final chicane. In 1999 it caught Damon Hill, Michael Schumacher and Jacques Villeneuve in the same race.

corners.name: The Hairpin (Turn 10)
corners.note: The slowest corner, at the end of a straight. Good for overtaking and for locking up.

moments.title: The Wall of Champions gets its name
moments.body: Three world champions crashed into the same wall on the exit of the last chicane in 1999. Montreal has called it the Wall of Champions ever since.

history.body: First race, and Gilles Villeneuve's first Grand Prix win.
Named after Gilles Villeneuve, who died earlier that year.
The longest race in F1 history: over four hours with a long rain stoppage. Jenson Button won after passing Sebastian Vettel on the last lap.
